verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair thing to ask of an API/SaaS product like Exa, so the axis applies. The evidence documents an official MCP server, a JS SDK, and agent skills, but no Exa CLI. The only command-line mention (exa-docs-33) is a single provisioning command run through Stripe Projects, which is account and API-key setup rather than an Exa CLI for search or agent workflows.
